title: Deterministic partial EPS - aggregate calibration and source-valued equipment modes
modelNotes: Battery capacities are sourced ratings at specified nominal operating conditions; no electrochemistry or temperature derating.
Ideal30V high-tap and28V low-tap outputs are a coarse voltage surrogate, not a discharge curve.
Equal connected-source sharing, ideal diodes and ideal inverter; wire resistance and conversion losses absent.
Every declared circuit breaker has a logical source bus and rated amperage. Individual operating draws remain unknown.
Two aggregate bus loads split total calibrated draw equally; this allocation is an explicit approximation and is not a set of component wattages.
Mission Report12A/30A presets are calibration cases, not independent flight validation.
Thermal breaker trip curve, detailed ECA protection, reverse current, thermal faults and full CWEA logic remain unmodelled.
Sourced-component mode uses only published operating input watts with switch/branch gates. It never adds aggregate calibration; full vehicle load coverage remains incomplete.
